protocol: Local development results: 28 primary frames (scenes 0038/0039/0045/0047) of the scene-disjoint 49-frame validation split, frozen robust20 cache, final checkpoint. ΔAbs20 = unweighted mean over the 20 corruptions of the mean |d_corr − d_clean|. Not official RobustSpring results. Seeds 2026 / 2027 / 2028; sd = sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) across independently trained runs, not a standard error or a confidence interval; three runs do not support significance claims.

repetitions.note: independent repetition of the seed-2028 run with the same configuration; reported next to it, not averaged
